invariants.rationale: The parameter is a float, so it must be within the valid float value range.
Java float 0 and 0.0f are equivalent; this captures that usage.
This expression is only true when value is not NaN, since NaN != NaN in Java; so it checks that value is not NaN.
The implementation assumes value is not NaN, e.g., when casting to int for array indexing, so not being NaN is meaningful.
